name: BTF Large Grants Window

funder.name: Bhutan Trust Fund for Environmental Conservation (BTFEC)

summary: Bhutan's conservation trust fund gives large grants for projects on biodiversity, human-wildlife coexistence, climate adaptation and development impacts, open to civil society, communities, agencies and others in Bhutan. Projects run up to three years.
reporting: Project partners submit semiannual technical, financial and procurement progress reports, which gate each fund release, and a project completion report at the end.

status.quote: no later than 7 July 2026, before 5.00 PM

deadline.quote: no later than 7 July 2026, before 5.00 PM

applicant_types.quote: Bhutanese agencies, civil society organizations, academic institutions, private sector entities, and individuals with innovative environmental initiatives.

geography.quote: supports environmental conservation, climate resilience, and sustainable development in Bhutan

access.quote: Applicants submit a Concept Note outlining the project rationale, objectives, expected outcomes, and estimated budget

window.quote: no later than 7 July 2026, before 5.00 PM

amount.quote: Up to Nu. 15 million per project (subject to Board approval)

reporting.quote: Project partners are required to submit semmiannual progress report for the first six months along with release request for the next/subsequent six months.
